opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering outstanding quality teaching in the fine and performing arts; must be UK based. Non‑specialist arts schools and multi‑faculty universities are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funds arts training for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours, covering tuition, maintenance, equipment, travel and related costs.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: maximum total award of £475,000; bursaries £5,000–£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions that award undergraduate or postgraduate degrees in the fine and performing arts; UK based. University departments are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5,000–£10,000 per year to outstanding undergraduate or postgraduate arts students in financial need.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 salary year 1, up to £28,000 salary years 2‑3; up to £6,000 research expenses per year; equipment up to £2,500 each; books up to £1,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with a doctorate who have not yet held a permanent full‑time academic post in the UK; must have submitted thesis by deadline, be UK resident, and meet career‑break criteria if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships supporting salary (100 % year 1, 50 % years 2‑3) and research expenses for early‑career scholars to undertake publishable work.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired senior researchers who have been UK university staff, UK resident for at least 26 weeks, and have an established research record.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired researchers to complete a research project (3–24 months) and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards up to £5 million total; each award funds up to 30 doctoral scholarships (plus master‑plus‑PhD and post‑doctoral opportunities) over a 9‑year period

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (or consortia of up to two) with research degree awarding powers; applications are made by institutions, not individuals.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for up to 30 interdisciplinary doctoral scholarships (and related master‑plus‑PhD and post‑doctoral posts) over a nine‑year award.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: up to £10 million per centre, up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (registered with the Office for Students and holding research degree awarding powers); single or collaborative centres allowed.
opportunities.summary: Funds establishment of interdisciplinary research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship, with up to £10 million over up to ten years.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Replacement salary costs; up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established, distinguished researchers in the humanities or social sciences, employed by a UK university (research degree awarding powers).
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowships providing salary replacement and up to £6,000 per year for research expenses to complete original research.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars (lecturer level or equivalent) with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK academic appointment, and who have not previously held a leadership award or managed a research team.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build a research team and demonstrate leadership over 4–5 years.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK higher‑education institutions, and eligible UK research institutes; principal investigator must be employed by the institution.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative research projects (up to five years) covering staff costs and associated research expenses.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university host academic coordinates the visit; visitor is an eminent senior professor from overseas. Host institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Funds 3–12 month visits by senior overseas professors to provide novel expertise, including a Leverhulme Lecture series.
